note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1: "If All-Active redundancy mode is desired, then the "Single-Active" bit in the flags of the ESI Label extended community MUST be set to 0 and the MPLS label in that Extended Community MUST be set to a valid MPLS label value." Two producer changes since the last judgement. a4fe1b70f3 moved generic attribute encoding out of evpn/config.go::parseConfigRoute to the central dispatcher; parseConfigRoute still merges its own and the configured extended communities and calls message.ValidateEVPNOriginationMode with params.RedundancyMode, so the ESI Label flag and label check on the config path is the same. 238bdb62e9 only renamed ParseESIString to parseESIString in encode.go::l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams, whose redundancy-mode placement guards are unchanged. The tagged carriers are byte-identical. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 0411b53e91). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1: "If All-Active redundancy mode is desired, then the "Single-Active" bit in the flags of the ESI Label extended community MUST be set to 0 and the MPLS label in that Extended Community MUST be set to a valid MPLS label value." Stale only because 0411b53e91 replaced the redundancy-mode argument with a routeIntent struct (redundancyMode plus overlayIndex) through parseL2VPNArgs, l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams, parseConfigRoute and EncodeRoute; the new overlay-index guard refuses only a named selector on a non-ip-prefix route and never touches the Ethernet A-D path. The tagged test units did not change. Both clauses stay proven as before (flag and valid-label refusals with exact text, flag-0 bytes and labels 16/1048575 accepted). Fresh overlay mutants (tags ze_core ze_bgp): parseConfigRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch; EncodeRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused; l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams dropping intent.redundancyMode reddens both; parseL2VPNArgs mapping single-active to all-active reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeAccepted, TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused and TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch. The message-package tests (TestRFC7432ESILabelRedundancyAccepted/Refused) are untouched by the change. Earlier open item unchanged: the config-path positive is only the untagged test/encode/evpn-per-es-redundancy-mode.ci, and the bgp-evpn-gobgp interop still owes its red proof.
